title: Free Now Bills Somewhere Else
caption:
Three "free" announcements in four days and I can't tell if I came out ahead.

Sept 13: Amp made the agent free with your own keys and started charging for the computer it runs on. Sept 14: Bolt gave Pro users up to 50× Forge usage until Oct 14, paid for with opted-in build sessions that help train an Arcee AI open model. Sept 16: Vercel's Hobby plan went from keeping 10 production deployments to 3, and over 10GB the rest delete immediately instead of after 30 days.

My honest take: none of these is a bad deal. But "free" stopped meaning "costs nothing" and started meaning "costs something that isn't on the invoice".

Which meter are you on?
